admissionInfo.text: Admission criteria includes: ENGL and MATH QL courses must have a grade C or higher. GPA of 2.7 or higher General Education and Pre-program coursework Grade of B- or higher in pre-program courses (Math courses C or higher) Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check (Recommended) Complete Autism Studies Minor (Optional) Completion of the Associate of Science degree in Pre-Elementary Education or equivalent (completion of this degree does not guarantee acceptance into the UVU Special Education Program)
